lessons.goal: 辨識贈與、回饋邀請及包裝說明中的條件。

questions.evidence: COMMUNITY SEED LIBRARY: Take one free packet to try growing something at home. You do not need to return the same number of seeds later. Sharing seeds from a successful harvest is welcome, but it is an invitation rather than a debt.
questions.explanation: 公告明說不必歸還同數種子。
options: No.
Only when they take one packet.
Yes, after exactly one week.
Only if they read the label.

questions.evidence: Each packet lists its suggested light conditions, container space, and expected range of growth. Read the label before choosing. options: To check whether its conditions fit their space.
To guarantee identical results.
To reserve every remaining packet.
To learn another user's private address.
questions.prompt: Why should users read the packet label?

questions.explanation: 借取紀錄協助管理補貨。
options: To prove every seed grew.
To reserve future packets automatically.
To create a debt of equal seeds.
To help track supplies that need replacing.

lessons.story:

Each packet lists its suggested light conditions, container space, and expected range of growth. Read the label before choosing. The photographs show examples, not a promise that every plant will look identical. Ask a helper if you are unsure how a label fits your available space.

Please write the packet name in the borrowing notebook so the center can track which supplies need replacing. This record does not reserve more packets for you. If your first attempt fails, you may describe what happened to the helper. The library encourages learning and honest records, not pretending that every seed grew successfully.
lessons.title: The Seed Library Is an Invitation
